verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair capability for a developer platform's dashboard, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant inside Cloudflare Workers itself. The managed MCP servers and Skills plugin serve external agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex), which is a host-agent workaround. The Agents SDK, the Think harness and Workers AI are developer building blocks for constructing your own agent, not an in-product assistant to delegate to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
